title: Wall St futures decline as US-Iran escalation rattles sentiment
title_zh: 由于美伊局势升级扰乱市场情绪，华尔街期货下跌
summary: By Ragini Mathur and Avinash P July 13 (Reuters) - Wall Street futures fell on Monday, as a fresh escalation between Iran and the U.S. in the Gulf rattled investors and sent oil prices higher, while
summary_zh: 路透拉吉尼·马图尔 (Ragini Mathur) 和阿维纳什·P (Avinash P) 7 月 13 日报道 - 华尔街期货周一下跌，原因是伊朗和美国在海湾地区的冲突升级令投资者感到不安，并推高了油价。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slip as US and Iran exchange fire, oil jumps
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货因美国和伊朗交火而下跌，油价上涨
summary: Markets were subdued ahead of a busy week for markets, with inflation reports, bank earnings, and geopolitical risk hanging in the balance.
summary_zh: 在市场繁忙的一周到来之前，市场表现疲软，通胀报告、银行盈利和地缘政治风险悬而未决。

title: Over 200 experts call for urgent action to tackle AI's economic impact
title_zh: 200 多名专家呼吁采取紧急行动应对人工智能的经济影响
summary: July 13 (Reuters) - More than 200 researchers and economists, including 15 Nobel laureates and researchers at OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, have called for governments and technology leaders to
summary_zh: 7 月 13 日（路透社）——200 多名研究人员和经济学家，其中包括 15 名诺贝尔奖获得者以及 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Google 的研究人员，呼吁政府和技术领导者

title: TSMC posts record revenue in second quarter on AI demand
title_zh: 人工智能需求推动台积电第二季度营收创历史新高
summary: STORY: TSMC reported record high second-quarter revenue on Monday. The world’s largest contract chipmaker posted that Q2 revenue rose 36% from a year earlier on surging interest in AI applications. Reuters calculated TSMC’s earnings came in at just over $39.6 billion...
summary_zh: 故事：台积电周一报告第二季度收入创历史新高。全球最大的代工芯片制造商表示，由于人们对人工智能应用的兴趣高涨，第二季度收入同比增长 36%。据路透社计算，台积电的盈利略高于 396 亿美元……

title: Apple’s $600 Billion Rally Fueled by Traders Fleeing AI Selloff
title_zh: 交易员逃离人工智能抛售推动苹果股价上涨 6000 亿美元
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Investors are flocking back to Apple Inc. as nervousness about artificial intelligence spending weighs on the stocks of chipmakers and cloud-computing giants.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——由于对人工智能支出的担忧令芯片制造商和云计算巨头的股票承压，投资者纷纷涌回苹果公司。

title: Meta expands Louisiana data center to 5 gigawatts compute capacity
title_zh: Meta 将路易斯安那州数据中心的计算能力扩展到 5 吉瓦
summary: July 13 (Reuters) - Meta said on Monday its data center in Richland Parish, Louisiana will expand to 5 gigawatts of compute capacity, in a bid to support the social media company's AI ambitions.
summary_zh: 7 月 13 日（路透社）——Meta 周一表示，其位于路易斯安那州里奇兰教区的数据中心的计算能力将扩大到 5 吉瓦，以支持这家社交媒体公司的人工智能雄心。

title: Meta expands Louisiana data center to 5 gigawatts, investment crosses $50 billion
title_zh: Meta 将路易斯安那州数据中心扩建至 5 吉瓦，投资突破 500 亿美元
summary: Meta said on Monday its data center in Richland Parish, Louisiana, will expand to 5 gigawatts ‌of compute capacity, with investment in the project increasing to ‌more than $50 billion.
summary_zh: Meta 周一表示，其位于路易斯安那州里奇兰教区的数据中心的计算能力将扩大至 5 吉瓦，该项目的投资将增加至超过 500 亿美元。

title: Meta’s Louisiana Data Center to Surpass $250 Billion Price Tag
title_zh: Meta 路易斯安那州数据中心的造价将超过 2500 亿美元

title: EU to Present Plan to Restrict Children’s Access to Social Media
title_zh: 欧盟将提出限制儿童使用社交媒体的计划
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The European Union will propose a law to restrict children’s access to social media, according to the bloc’s top official, as part of a growing global consensus about the harm it causes.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——据欧盟高级官员称，欧盟将提出一项限制儿童使用社交媒体的法律，作为全球对其造成的危害日益增长的共识的一部分。
